rules.background: every change kept by these rules, at any residue, counted per entry and residue class
rules.depmap: a missense or stop call on the canonical isoform (UniprotID unlabelled or -1, else VepSwissprot) whose residue the 2026_03 canonical sequence has at the position; one row per (entry, position, new residue, line)
rules.tcga: FILTER PASS; in TCGA-OV and TCGA-LAML also FILTER wga alone (Ellrott et al. 2018); a missense or stop change on a transcript UniProt assigns to a reviewed entry's displayed isoform (all_effects); where the variant falls in no such transcript, a Missense_Mutation or Nonsense_Mutation of the MAF transcript (HGVSp_Short), placed on the entry SWISSPROT names, else on the entries of the gene symbol; kept where the 2026_03 canonical sequence has the changed residue at the position; one row per (entry, position, new residue, tumor sample)

cases.url: https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/cases (filter project.program.name = TCGA; fields submitter_id, project.project_id, project.name)

crispr_gene_effect_header.note: the header line of CRISPRGeneEffect.csv (DepMap 24Q4, MD5 of the whole file 6edf7ade09b9b34199210b559d4745d3)

clinvar_disease_families.rule: conditions split on | and ;, without not specified, not provided and see cases; classify_clinvar(); Other / unassigned left out; sorted; ";"-joined

clinvar.rule: a single-residue substitution or stop on a RefSeq protein UniProt assigns to a reviewed entry's displayed isoform, kept where the 2026_03 canonical sequence has the residue at the position; classifications from the GRCh38 rows of variant_summary; one row per (entry, position, new residue, variation)

propensity.germline_rates: gnomAD mutation_rate_methylation_bins (gs://gcp-public-data--gnomad/papers/2019-flagship-lof/v1.0/model/mutation_rate_methylation_bins.txt.bgz; the gnomAD v2.1.1 flagship paper, Karczewski et al., Nature 581:434, 2020; CC0)

rules.burden: coding calls per Mb of coding sequence (32301341 bp, each GRCh38 position once); hypermutated above 10 per Mb (Campbell et al., Cell 171:1042 (2017), doi:10.1016/j.cell.2017.09.048); DepMap OmicsSomaticMutations.csv keeps synonymous calls only where they touch a splice region
rules.coding_sequence: Ensembl 105 transcripts UniProt assigns to the displayed isoform (scripts/44b canonical_transcripts) whose GTF CDS records on the GRCh38 primary assembly translate with the standard code to the 2026_03 canonical sequence
rules.germline_rates: gnomAD mutation_rate_methylation_bins (Karczewski et al., Nature 581:434 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41586-020-2308-7), CC0, bytes unchanged
rules.h3: TCGA and DepMap changes at every residue of the entries named Histone H3*, by the rules of scripts/66
rules.methylation: gnomAD v2.1.1 flagship methylation table (GRCh37) at the GRCh38 position lifted with Ensembl GRCh38_to_GRCh37; gnomad_lof constraint_utils/constraint_basics.py, prepare_ht (https://github.com/macarthur-lab/gnomad_lof): methylation_level 2 where a CpG transition's methylation MEAN > 0.6, 1 where > 0.2, else 0
rules.somatic_spectra: residue-changing SNVs in the coding positions over the residue-changing substitutions there, 96 pyrimidine-centered classes; TCGA kept calls (scripts/66 rules) placed on GRCh38 through the lifted coding positions; DepMap SNVs
